SELECT
    o.observstation AS observatory_name,
    COUNT(s.signalregistry) AS signals_meeting_thresholds,
    AVG(sp.anomscore) AS avg_origin_score,
    AVG(s.freqmhz / s.bwhz) AS avg_frequency_ratios,
    (COUNT(s.signalregistry) * 100.0 / (
        SELECT COUNT(*) 
        FROM signals s
        INNER JOIN signalprobabilities sp ON s.signalregistry = sp.signalref
        WHERE sp.techsigprob > 0.5
    )) AS percentage_of_candidates
FROM observatories o
INNER JOIN telescopes t ON o.observstation = t.observstation
INNER JOIN signals s ON t.telescregistry = s.telescref
INNER JOIN signalprobabilities sp ON s.signalregistry = sp.signalref
WHERE sp.techsigprob > 0.5
GROUP BY o.observstation
ORDER BY signals_meeting_thresholds DESC;
